title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Rate Sheet: Credit Tiers and Booking Limits
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — tier placement and booking limits, all tiers**

Every Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease is booked in one of six tiers, from Kestrel Lease Tier 5 to Kestrel Lease Tier 1+. The tier is the one whose credit score band (FICO Auto Score 8) contains the lessee's score, and the tier's limits below are the ones the lease must meet when it is written and funded.

| Tier | Credit score band | Lease term (months) | Gross capitalized cost, at most | Capitalized cost reduction, at least | Total monthly payment, at most |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Lease Tier 5 | 600 to 639 | 24 to 36 | 105% of MSRP | 10% of MSRP | 10% of verified gross monthly income |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 4 | 640 to 669 | 24 to 39 | 110% of MSRP | 5% of MSRP | 12% of verified gross monthly income |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 3 | 670 to 699 | 24 to 39 | 115% of MSRP | 3% of MSRP | 13% of verified gross monthly income |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 2 | 700 to 719 | 24 to 48 | 120% of MSRP | 0% of MSRP | 15% of verified gross monthly income |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1 | 720 to 749 | 24 to 48 | 120% of MSRP | 0% of MSRP | 16% of verified gross monthly income |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1+ | 750 to 900 | 24 to 48 | 125% of MSRP | 0% of MSRP | 18% of verified gross monthly income |

The shortest lease term is 24 months in every tier; the longest is the upper figure of the term column.

| Tier | Security deposit required | Deposit rounding increment | Acquisition fee | Relationship exposure cap | Funding window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Lease Tier 5 | Yes | $25 | $695 | $40000 | 30 calendar days |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 4 | Yes | $25 | $695 | $55000 | 30 calendar days |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 3 | Yes | $25 | $695 | $80000 | 30 calendar days |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 2 | No | $25 | $695 | $105000 | 30 calendar days |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1 | No | $25 | $695 | $145000 | 30 calendar days |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1+ | No | $25 | $695 | $190000 | 30 calendar days |

**Reading the columns**

- *Security deposit required / rounding increment*: where a deposit is required it equals one total monthly payment rounded up to the next $25; where it is not required, no deposit is taken.
- *Acquisition fee*: the lease acquisition fee, capitalized or paid at signing.
- *Relationship exposure cap*: the maximum combined Kestrel consumer exposure for the customer including the new lease.
- *Funding window*: the calendar days after the lease date within which the dealer must deliver a complete lease package for the lease to be funded.

**Points of reading**

- A score of 669 places the lease in Kestrel Lease Tier 4; a score of 670 places it in Kestrel Lease Tier 3. The bands do not overlap, and each band includes both of its end figures.
- Hypothetical example: a lessee with a score of 705 falls in Kestrel Lease Tier 2, which may book a term of up to 48 months, takes no security deposit and carries a relationship exposure cap of $105000.
